arxiv-2203-11091.title: GCNET: A novel graph-based approach for prediction of stock price movement
arxiv-2203-11091.creator: Alireza Jafari, Saman Haratizadeh
arxiv-2203-11091.description: Abstract The importance of considering related stocks data for the prediction of stock price movement has been shown in many studies, however, advanced graphical techniques for modeling, embedding and analyzing the behavior of inter-related stocks have not been widely exploited for the prediction of stocks price movements yet.

arxiv-2204-06324.title: Rank One Approximation as a Strategy for Wordle Thanks: I would like to thank Dr. Ilie Ugarcovici (DePaul Unviersity) for advice and encouragement on the project, Amrita Bhattacharyya for editorial insight, and DePaul University for research support.
arxiv-2204-06324.creator: Michael Bonthron
arxiv-2204-06324.description: Abstract . This paper presents a mathematical method of playing the puzzle game Wordle. In Wordle, the player has six tries to guess a secret word. After each guess the player is told how their guess compares to the secret word. With the available information the player makes their next guess.

arxiv-2205-00679.title: Mass-spectra of light-heavy tetraquarks Spectroscopy of light-heavy flavoured tetraquark states.
arxiv-2205-00679.creator: ROHIT TIWARI, JUHI OUDICHHYA and AJAY KUMAR RAI
arxiv-2205-00679.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by ROHIT TIWARI, JUHI OUDICHHYA and AJAY KUMAR RAI. The mass spectra of light-heavy tetraquarks c ​ q ​ c ¯ ​ q ¯ cq\bar{c}\bar{q} (q= u, d) are computed in a non-relativistic diquark model with one-gluon exchange plus confining potential. In the diquark model, a c ​ q ​ c ¯ ​ q ¯ cq\bar{c}\bar{q} state is regarded to be made of a light-heavy diquark (qc) and an antidiquark q ¯ ​ c ¯ \bar{q}\bar{c} in triplet and antitriplet colour configuration respectively.

arxiv-2310-10844.title: Survey of Vulnerabilities in Large Language Models Revealed by Adversarial Attacks
arxiv-2310-10844.creator: Erfan Shayegani, Md Abdullah Al Mamun, Yu Fu, Pedram Zaree, Yue Dong, Nael Abu-Ghazaleh
arxiv-2310-10844.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) are swiftly advancing in architecture and capability, and as they integrate more deeply into complex systems, the urgency to scrutinize their security properties grows. This paper surveys research in the emerging interdisciplinary field of adversarial attacks on LLMs, a subfield of trustworthy ML, combining the perspectives of Natural Language Processing and Security.

arxiv-2312-01992.title: Whence Nonlocality? Removing spooky action at a distance from the de Broglie Bohm pilot-wave theory using a time-symmetric version of de Broglie double solution
arxiv-2312-01992.creator: Aurélien Drezet 1
arxiv-2312-01992.description: Abstract In this work, we review and extend a version of the old attempt made by Louis de broglie for interpreting quantum mechanics in realistic terms, namely the double solution. In this theory quantum particles are localized waves, i.e, solitons, that are solutions of relativistic nonlinear field equations.

arxiv-2407-12225.title: Probabilistic Reachability Analysis of Stochastic Control Systems
arxiv-2407-12225.creator: Saber Jafarpour, Zishun Liu, Yongxin Chen
arxiv-2407-12225.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Saber Jafarpour, Zishun Liu, Yongxin Chen. We address the reachability problem for continuous-time stochastic dynamic systems. Our objective is to present a unified framework that characterizes the reachable set of a dynamic system in the presence of both stochastic disturbances and deterministic inputs. To achieve this, we devise a strategy that effectively decouples the effects of deterministic inputs and stochastic disturbances on the reachable sets of the system. For the deterministic part, many existing methods can capture the deterministic reachability.

arxiv-2410-05171.title: Single-shot preparation of hypergraph product codes via dimension jump
arxiv-2410-05171.creator: Yifan Hong
arxiv-2410-05171.description: Abstract Quantum error correction is a fundamental primitive of fault-tolerant quantum computing. But in order for error correction to proceed, one must first prepare the codespace of the underlying error-correcting code. A popular method for encoding quantum low-density parity-check codes is transversal initialization, where one begins in a product state and measures a set of stabilizer generators.

arxiv-2503-17700.title: MAMAT: 3D Mamba-Based Atmospheric Turbulence Removal and its Object Detection Capability
arxiv-2503-17700.creator: Paul Hill, Zhiming Liu, Nantheera Anantrasirichai
arxiv-2503-17700.description: Abstract Restoration and enhancement are essential for improving the quality of videos captured under atmospheric turbulence conditions, aiding visualization, object detection, classification, and tracking in surveillance systems. In this paper, we introduce a novel Mamba-based method, the 3D Mamba-Based Atmospheric Turbulence Removal (MAMAT), which employs a dual-module strategy to mitigate these distortions.

arxiv-2510-00964.title: Social Photo-elicitation: The Use of Communal Production of Meaning to Hear a Vulnerable Population Journal: PACMHCI Volume: 2 CSCW 56 11 DOI: 10.1145/3274325 CCS: Human-centered computing Field studies CCS: Human-centered computing Ethnographic studies CCS: Human-centered computing User studies
arxiv-2510-00964.creator: Aakash Gautam, Chandani Shrestha, Steve Harrison, Deborah Tatar
arxiv-2510-00964.description: Abstract . We report on an initial ethnographic exploration of the situation of sex-trafficking survivors in Nepal. In the course of studying trafficking survivors in a protected-living situation created by a non-governmental organization in Nepal, we adapted photo-elicitation to hear the voices of the survivors by making the technique more communal.

arxiv-2601-07959.title: Robust Stable Matchings: Dealing with Changes in Preferences
arxiv-2601-07959.creator: Rohith Reddy Gangam, Tung Mai, Nitya Raju, Vijay V. Vazirani
arxiv-2601-07959.description: Abstract We study stable matchings that are robust to preference changes in the two-sided stable matching setting of Gale and Shapley GS 62 . Given two instances A A and B B on the same set of agents, a matching is said to be robust if it is stable under both instances.

pmc-10598267.title: DNAJA4 suppresses epithelial-mesenchymal transition and metastasis in nasopharyngeal carcinoma via PSMD2-mediated MYH9 degradation
pmc-10598267.creator: Qun Zhang, Ping Feng, Xun-Hua Zhu, Shi-Qing Zhou, Ming-Liang Ye, Xiao-Jing Yang, Sha Gong, Sheng-Yan Huang, Xi-Rong Tan, Shi-Wei He, Ying-Qing Li
pmc-10598267.description: Emerging evidence indicates that DNA methylation plays an important role in the initiation and progression of nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC). DNAJA4 is hypermethylated in NPC, while its role in regulating NPC progression remains unclear. Here, we revealed that the promoter of DNAJA4 was hypermethylated and its expression was downregulated in NPC tissues and cells.

pmc-10735417.title: FAMILY DYNAMICS IN CARING FOR PEOPLE WITH DEMENTIA DURING THE COVID-19 PANDEMIC
pmc-10735417.creator: HwaJung Choi, Amanda Leggett
pmc-10735417.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). A nuanced understanding of family care dynamics (e.g., change in care availability, care network, and care involvement) is important to assess the coping mechanism in dementia care during the pandemic. We conducted an explanatory sequential mixed methods study.

pmc-11362012.title: A TNIP1-driven systemic autoimmune disorder with elevated IgG4
pmc-11362012.creator: Arti Medhavy, Vicki Athanasopoulos, Katharine Bassett, Yuke He, Maurice Stanley, Daniel Enosi Tuipulotu, Jean Cappello, Grant J. Brown, Paula Gonzalez-Figueroa, Cynthia Turnbull, Somasundhari Shanmuganandam, Padmaja Tummala, Gemma Hart, Tom Lea-Henry, Hao Wang, Sonia Nambadan, Qian Shen, Jonathan A.
pmc-11362012.description: Whole-exome sequencing of two unrelated kindreds with systemic autoimmune disease featuring antinuclear antibodies with IgG4 elevation uncovered an identical ultrarare heterozygous TNIP1Q333P variant segregating with disease. Mice with the orthologous Q346P variant developed antinuclear autoantibodies, salivary gland inflammation, elevated IgG2c, spontaneous germinal centers and expansion of age-associated B cells, plasma cells and follicular and extrafollicular helper T cells.

pmc-11475206.title: Real-world efficacy of PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors in patients with advanced pulmonary neuroendocrine carcinoma: a single-center analysis
pmc-11475206.creator: Wanchen Zhai, Ying Yu, Haicheng Wu, Qian Zhang, Yunfei Chen, Yehao Yang, Yun Fan
pmc-11475206.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background:Immunotherapy blocking programmed death-1 (PD-1)/programmed death ligand-1 (PD-L1) has revolutionized the treatment of extensive-stage small-cell lung cancer (SCLC), but only with limited real-world efficacy data; evidence from immunotherapy for other pulmonary neuroendocrine carcinoma (PNEC) is scarce.Objective:The purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficacy of receiving PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors in patients with advanced PNEC and explore factors related to survival prognosis, providing clues for treatment for patients with advanced PNEC.Methods:In all, 203 patients with advanced PNEC who received PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors between January

pmc-11514604.title: Renal Function Is Associated with Changes in Bone Mineral Density in Postmenopausal Osteoporotic Women Treated with Denosumab: Data From a Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-11514604.creator: Antonino Catalano, Cecilia Oliveri, Giuseppe Natale, Rita Maria Agostino, Giovanni Squadrito, Agostino Gaudio, Guido Gembillo, Djordje Marina, Valeria Cernaro, Elisa Longhitano, Giorgio Basile, Nunziata Morabito, Domenico Santoro, Johannes Ott, Peter Schnuelle
pmc-11514604.description: Background/Objectives: Renal function influences bone metabolism, as kidney failure can increase the risk of fractures. Denosumab is an approved osteoporosis treatment, but its efficacy in relation to renal function has not yet been studied in real-life scenarios. This study aimed to investigate the denosumab-induced change in bone mineral density (BMD) according to kidney function.

pmc-11598886.title: The Predictive Role of miRNAs in Hepatitis B Vaccine Response of Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease Patients
pmc-11598886.creator: Gamze Guney Eskiler, Oguz Karabay, Mukaddes Tozlu, Ayhan Aydin, Kaan Furkan Hamarat, Umut Alkurt, Asuman Deveci Ozkan, Yasemin Gunduz
pmc-11598886.description: (1) Background: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is the most common chronic liver disease. Although the changes in the expression levels of microRNAs (miRNAs) in hepatitis B virus-related diseases have been evaluated, no study has evaluated the role of miRNAs in HBV vaccine response in MASLD patients.

pmc-11651798.title: ABALON regulates mitophagy and 5-FU sensitivity in colorectal cancer via PINK1-Parkin pathway
pmc-11651798.creator: Huimin Liu, Ying Huang, Chunmei Zhao, Guihua Wang, Xudong Wang
pmc-11651798.description: BackgroundGrowing evidence demonstrated that long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) are closely related with chemoresistance in colorectal cancer (CRC). Mitophagy serves as an essential factor to maintain the quality of tumor cells. However, it is unclear whether lncRNAs are involved in mitophagy regulation in CRC.

pmc-11713342.title: Event‐based modeling of T‐N mismatch reveals distinct spatio‐temporal trajectories of subtypes with likely co‐pathology in Alzheimer’s disease
pmc-11713342.creator: Xueying Lyu, Paul A Yushkevich, Stanislau Hrybouski, Yue Li, Michael Tran Duong, Long Xie, Laura EM Wisse, Robin de Flores, David J Irwin, Bradford C Dickerson, Ilya M Nasrallah, Sandhitsu R Das, David A Wolk
pmc-11713342.description: BackgroundThe heterogeneity of Alzheimer’s disease (AD) and lack of well‐validated markers of co‐pathologies present a substantial challenge for therapeutics. We previously found phenotypes defined by Tau (T) ‐ Neurodegeneration (N) discordance linked to non‐Alzheimer’s pathologies (e.g. TDP‐43, vascular disease). In this work, we aim to leverage T‐N mismatch for identifying distinct spatial‐temporal progression patterns of non‐AD pathologies.

pmc-12512780.title: The impact of zinc and testosterone co-treatment on tumourigenesis in prostate cancer: a novel model
pmc-12512780.creator: Kofi Oduro Yeboah, Paul Atawuchugi, Fredrick Kwadwo Baah, Bernard Elikplim Petershie, Yolanda Ashie, Eric Boakye-Gyasi, Newman Osafo, Emmanuel Amankwah Ntim, George Ainooson
pmc-12512780.description: BackgroundPre-clinical models play a key role in prostate cancer research, helping to understand the mechanism of the disease. The unavailability of suitable animal models in under-resourced areas, such as in sub-Saharan African (SSA) countries, presents a major barrier for them to contribute meaningfully to developing effective treatments and preventive strategies in this global effort against prostate cancer.

pmc-13408819.title: Learning to Reformulate Peer Conflict: Effects of a Language-Based Educational Program on Conflict Management, Peer Interaction, and Bullying-Related Experiences in Early Adolescence
pmc-13408819.creator: Katia Rolán, Francisca Fariña, Miguel Cuevas-Alonso
pmc-13408819.description: Peer conflict in early adolescence ranges from everyday disagreements to repeated aggression and bullying-related experiences. Bullying should not be reduced to physical violence: it may involve relational exclusion, psychological harassment, or verbal aggression without direct physical harm, whereas isolated aggressive acts do not necessarily constitute bullying.

pmc-13556811.title: 555. Targeting kynurenine aminotransferase III: discovery of a selective and brain-penetrant inhibitor for reducing synthesis of immune-induced kynurenic acid
pmc-13556811.creator: P Fridh, Y Gravenfors, L Schwieler, V Louvrou, M Gómez-Galán, R Caraballo, J Larsson, C Bengtsson, L Dahllund, E Woestenenk, N Nekhotiaeva, H Nordström, A Roos, A Lindqvist, E Johnson, S Erhardt
pmc-13556811.description: BackgroundKynurenic acid (KYNA) is a neuroactive metabolite produced via the kynurenine pathway. It acts as an endogenous N-methyl-D-aspartic acid (NMDA) receptor antagonist and is proposed to antagonize the α7-nicotinic acetylcholine receptor (α7nAChR). Elevated KYNA levels are observed in several conditions, including psychotic disorders and infectious diseases, where interference with glutamatergic and dopaminergic neurotransmission contributes to psychosis and cognitive decline.

pmc-13630533.title: High-Yield and High-Titer Production of Levulinic Acid from Red Macroalgae via Sulfuric Acid-Catalyzed Hydrolysis: Optimization by Response Surface Methodology and Application to Actual Biomass
pmc-13630533.creator: Im Su Kang, Seon Hui Kim, Jun Hee Jang, Kyoung Heon Kim, Dong Hyun Kim
pmc-13630533.description: Levulinic acid (LA) is a versatile bio-based platform chemical with wide-ranging applications in biofuels, solvents, and biodegradable materials. To establish an efficient LA production strategy, red macroalgae were selected as the biomass feedstock due to their high carbohydrate content—particularly galactan, which is rich in 3,6-anhydro-L-galactose (AHG), a sugar that readily converts to LA under acidic conditions.
